an4.70:1.1: At whatever time, monastics, there are dishonest kings, at that time royal agents are dishonest. In the tenth (discourse in this section) there are dishonest (kings) means
an4.70:1.2: When there are dishonest royal agents at that time brahmins and householders are dishonest. When there are dishonest brahmins and householders
an4.70:1.3: at that time the citizens are dishonest.
an4.70:1.4: When there are dishonest citizens moon and sun move irregularly.
an4.70:1.5: When there is the irregular movement of the moon and sun the constellations and stars move irregularly.
an4.70:1.6: When there is the irregular movement of the constellations and stars night and day move irregularly. When there is the irregular movement of night and day
an4.70:1.7: the months and fortnights move irregularly. When there is the irregular movement of the months and fortnights
an4.70:1.8: the seasons and years move irregularly.
an4.70:1.9: When there is the irregular movement of the seasons and years the blowing of the winds is irregular and abnormal.
an4.70:1.10: When there is the irregular and abnormal movement of the winds the gods become agitated. The gods become agitated means because of irregular and abnormal winds
an4.70:1.11: When the gods are agitated the gods do not give proper (rain). Therefore the gods become agitated, Because of that this was said: the gods do not give the proper (rain)
an4.70:1.12: When the gods do not give proper (rain) the crops ripen irregularly. The crops ripen irregularly means thus the crops ripen irregularly.
an4.70:1.13: When the crops ripen irregularly, monastics, humans who eat them have a short life, are ugly and have many illnesses.
an4.70:2.1: At whatever time, monastics, there are honest kings, at that time royal agents are honest.
an4.70:2.2: When there are honest royal agents at that time brahmins and householders are honest.
an4.70:2.3: When there are honest brahmins and householders at that time the citizens are honest.
an4.70:2.4: When there are honest citizens the moon and sun move regularly.
an4.70:2.5: When there is the regular movement of the moon and sun the constellations and stars move regularly. The constellations and stars move regularly means therefore they move properly.
an4.70:2.6: When there is the regular movement of the constellations and stars night and day move regularly.
an4.70:2.7: When there is the regular movement of night and day the months and fortnights move regularly.
an4.70:2.8: When there is the regular movement of the months and fortnights the seasons and years move regularly.
an4.70:2.9: When there is the regular movement of the seasons and years the blowing of the winds is regular and normal.
an4.70:2.10: When there is the regular and normal movement of the winds the gods become calm.
an4.70:2.11: When the gods are calm the gods give proper (rain).
an4.70:2.12: When the gods give proper (rain) the crops ripen regularly.
an4.70:2.13: When the crops ripen regularly, monastics, humans who eat them have a long life, are beautiful and have few illnesses.
an4.70:3.1: If, when cattle are hurrying, the leader goes off course,
an4.70:3.4: as the leader is going off course. The leader is going off course, here leader means (their) guide.
an4.70:4.2: he who is agreed upon as the chief,
an4.70:4.4: what to say of the other people?
an4.70:4.5: The whole country sleeps badly if the king is dishonest.
an4.70:5.1: If, when cattle are hurrying, as the leader is going straight,
an4.70:5.4: following the one who goes straight.
an4.70:6.2: he who is agreed upon as the chief,
an4.70:6.4: what to say of the other people?
an4.70:6.5: The whole country will sleep happily if the king is but honest.
